items.title: Maresca's dream start turns into nightmare as title hopes hit
items.description: Enzo Maresca left the City Ground on Saturday evening with chants of "can we play you every week?" ringing in his ears - the Italian's dream start as Manchester City manager is rapidly turning into a nightmare.

items.title: Maresca looking to understand Man City's 'lack of intensity'
items.description: Enzo Maresca feels his side "lacked intensity" as Manchester City suffered their third Premier League defeat in a row, losing 3-1 to Nottingham Forest at the City Ground.

items.title: Hits and misses: Could Konsa hold off Saliba's return?
Delap double inspires Forest to stunning win over Man City
items.description: Liam Delap scores a superb double as Nottingham Forest stun Manchester City 3-1 for their first Premier League win at the City Ground this season.

items.title: Muniz strike denies Newcastle and Jaissle much-needed win
items.description: Rodrigo Muniz scores his first goal since the opening day of last season as Fulham deny Newcastle and head coach Matthias Jaissle a much-needed win at Craven Cottage.

items.title: Leeds beat Spurs to end five-game winless run
items.description: Noah Okafor scores the only goal of the game to give Leeds United their first win since the 14th of September, as Tottenham are beaten 1-0 at Elland Road in the Premier League.

items.title: Arsenal beat Hull to extend lead at top of the table
items.description: Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard scores the winner as his side beat Hull City to extend their lead at the top of the Premier League table.

items.title: Newport cup tie halted by alleged homophobic chants
items.description: Newport manager Hayden Mullins condemns alleged abusive chants during Saturday's FA Cup tie against Walsall.

items.title: Delightful Delap stars as Forest shock Man City
items.description: FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from the Premier League match between Nottingham Forest and Manchester City.

items.title: Another 1-0 for relentless Arsenal - but did Odegaard spare VAR blushes?
items.description: Arsenal move six points clear at the top of the Premier League after beating Hull City - but did Martin Odegaard's goal save the blushes of the VAR?

items.title: Forest end goal drought to make it three defeats in a row for Man City
items.description: Liam Delap scored two as Nottingham Forest ended their goal drought in style to beat Manchester City 3-1 at the City Ground.

items.title: Delightful Delap and outfought Anderson - Forest v Man City player ratings
items.description: How Nottingham Forest and Manchester City's players rated following their Premier League match at the City Ground.
